# Purify Food and Drink (`spells:purify-food-and-drink`)
**Level 1 [Transmutation](../magic-schools/transmutation.md) (Ritual)** | **Casting Time:** Action | **Range:** 10 feet
**Components:** V, S | **Duration:** Instantaneous | **Classes:** [Cleric](../classes/cleric.md), [Druid](../classes/druid.md), [Paladin](../classes/paladin.md)

You remove poison and rot from nonmagical food and drink in a 5-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point within range.
